title: Gaussian exponent identity
statement:
Let $n$ be a natural number, let $\rho,s\in\mathbb R$ with $s\ne0$, and let $x,y\in\mathbb R^n$. Then
\[\sum_{i=1}^n -\frac{(\rho y_i-x_i)^2}{2s^2}=-\frac12\sum_{i=1}^n\left(\frac{x_i}{s}-\frac{\rho y_i}{s}\right)^2.\]
